key.name: override-restrictions
key.summary: Override document restrictions
key.description: Override document restrictions, like restriction to copy or to print.

key.name: document-directory
key.summary: The URI of the directory last used to open or save a document

key.name: pictures-directory
key.summary: The URI of the directory last used to save a picture

key.name: page-cache-size
key.summary: Page cache size in MiB
key.description: The maximum size that will be used to cache rendered pages, limits maximum zoom level.

key.name: allow-links-change-zoom
key.summary: Allow links to change the zoom level.

key.name: sidebar-width
key.summary: Width of the side bar, in pixels.
key.description: Shared by every tab so the side bar does not change width when switching between documents. Acts as a ceiling: making the window wider never widens the side bar past it.

key.name: sidebar-width-fraction
key.summary: Width of the side bar as a fraction of the window width.
key.description: Used only while the window is narrow enough that this fraction falls below sidebar-width, so the side bar gives ground as the window shrinks. Stored alongside the pixel width so a tab opened later reproduces it exactly, without having to measure a window that may not be laid out yet.

key.name: highlight-style
key.summary: How the selected row in the side bar lists is marked.
key.description: Either a filled background or just a coloured border, as the search results list uses.

key.name: tab-highlight-style
key.summary: How the selected tab is marked.
key.description: "underline" tints the tab and underlines it in the accent colour, "filled" only tints it, and "default" leaves the plain grey libadwaita draws. Independent of highlight-style, which is about the side bar lists.

key.name: accent-source
key.summary: Where the accent colour comes from.
key.description: "system" follows the desktop, "upstream" uses the default blue, anything else names a fixed accent.

key.name: keep-outline-expanded
key.summary: Keep outline sections expanded once they have been opened.
key.description: When false, sections collapse again as the document is scrolled past them.

key.name: collapse-sidebar-when-narrow
key.summary: Collapse the side bar automatically in a narrow window.
key.description: When false the side bar keeps its width however narrow the window becomes.

key.name: open-in-new-tab
key.summary: Open further documents in a new tab rather than a new window.

key.name: show-outline-toggle
key.summary: Show the outline expand/collapse button in the side bar header.
key.description: The keyboard shortcut works whether or not the button is shown.

key.name: custom-shortcuts
key.summary: Overrides for the customizable shortcuts.
key.description: Maps ids from the curated table in shortcuts.rs to accelerator strings; ids not present keep their default.

key.name: show-zoom-overlay
key.summary: Show the floating zoom and annotation controls over the document.

key.name: enable-spellchecking
key.summary: Check spelling when writing annotation notes or filling text forms.

key.name: show-sidebar
key.summary: Show a side bar next to the document to help navigate the document.

key.name: zoom
key.summary: Set the default zoom level to display a document.

key.name: continuous
key.summary: Display the document as a continuous stream of pages instead of page at a time.

key.name: dual-page
key.summary: Show two pages side by side.

key.name: dual-page-odd-left
key.summary: Show the first page (odd page) on the left (when displaying two pages side by side)
